'''John Robert Anderson''' (5 March 1928 – 26 February 2007) was an Australian chemist whose research specialised on [[materials science]]. Anderson served as Chief of the Division of Material Sciences at the [[Commonwealth Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation]] from 1970 to 1978. He attended [[Sydney Boys High School]] from 1940 to 1944.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Professors |url=http://www.shsobu.org.au/wp-content/uploads/professors.pdf |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190323090429/http://www.shsobu.org.au/wp-content/uploads/Professors.pdf |archive-date=23 March 2019 |access-date=31 May 2024 |website=shsobu.org.au}}</ref>
